description: Seed social links, revise bond and state, and manage structural ties. Seed a link as soon as a relationship is mentioned — do not wait for repeated evidence.

inputSchema.description: Seed social links, revise bond and state, and manage structural ties.

bond.description: Bond text. Required when action=revise_bond. Null to clear.

from.description: Source contact. Required when action=seed_social_link or set_structural_tie. Provide contactId or identity.

input.description: Full payload for seed_social_link or set_structural_tie. Alternative to top-level kind/role.

kind.description: Link kind. Required for seed_social_link and set_structural_tie. Can be passed here or inside input. For seed_social_link: personal, family, professional, romantic, care, service, observed, other_relational. For set_structural_tie: works_at, manages, member_of, married_to, partner_of, parent_of, child_of, sibling_of, friend_of, client_of, vendor_of, reports_to, belongs_to, other_structural.

link.description: Target link. Required when action=revise_bond, override_state, or remove_structural_tie. Provide linkId or endpoints.

now.description: Optional timestamp. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

removedAt.description: Removal timestamp. Optional for action=remove_structural_tie. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

role.description: Optional role for seed_social_link or set_structural_tie. Can be passed here or inside input.

to.description: Target contact. Required when action=seed_social_link or set_structural_tie. Provide contactId or identity.

name: manage_relationship
